Analyst estimates Anthropic’s IPO proceeds and recent funding could leave it with over $230 billion in cash, supporting operations and computing capacity purchases from Amazon, Google and SpaceX.
Anthropic (ANT) completed a $26 billion private share placement at its IPO price. Nvidia was among seven buyers. The prospectus cites Nvidia-based computing deals and chip use from Amazon and Google.

William Blair began ANT coverage at Outperform, citing a valuation that could imply $130–$150 per share. Morningstar kept its $92 fair value estimate; Seaport Research rated ANT Neutral.
